node.title: Re^3: open input files once
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
What is // doing in the above code?

// in this case is the [doc://perlop#Logical-Defined-Or] (as opposed to the empty regular expression, for example in "$foo =~ //;"). The expression $data{$key}{$file} // 0 is the same as defined($data{$key}{$file}) ? $data{$key}{$file} : 0
